title: stevia rebaudiana
intro: Stevia rebaudiana, commonly known as sweetleaf or sugarleaf, is a perennial plant native to South America, prized for its sweet taste and medicinal properties. Stevia rebaudiana has been found to have numerous health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, reducing blood sugar levels, and improving oral health. The therapeutic actions of Stevia rebaudiana include acting as an antihypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, and gum disease. The bioactive constituents of Stevia rebaudiana include glycosides, flavonoids, and terpenoids, specifically steviol and rebaudioside A, which are responsible for its sweet taste and medicinal properties.
